summary.one_liner: VMware's corporate site, promoting its enterprise private cloud and infrastructure platform (notably VMware Cloud Foundation) for running VMs, containers, and AI/ML workloads.
use_cases: Run VMs and containers on a private cloud
Test VMware Cloud Foundation in hands-on labs
summary.what_it_does: The page describes VMware's platform for unifying compute, storage, networking, management, and security on one private cloud. It positions the platform for delivering applications including virtual machines, containers, and AI/ML workloads. It mentions integrated compliance, protection, detection, and recovery against cyberattacks, plus security and governance for agentic AI workloads. It links to free hands-on labs for VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 and to information about running AI models on premises on VCF. The page is mostly marketing and names no specific prices or technical specifications.
notable: VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 with hands-on labs
Unified compute, storage, networking, management and security on one private cloud
On-premises AI model hosting path on VCF
Security and governance for agentic AI workloads
caveats: Page is mainly marketing; no pricing or detailed specs given
Enterprise-focused platform; pricing and licensing not stated on this page
